title: The Lantern at Dusk
description: A terrible blight is spreading from the old barrow in the hills — the same barrow where a cursed lantern was buried centuries ago. The lantern must be brought to a stone circle in the valley to break the curse. But the barrow is not empty.
author: Nicholas A. Gasper
notes: A one-shot introductory adventure showcasing core mechanics.

bestiary.name: Duskwight
bestiary.description: A restless spirit bound to the barrow. It drifts through the corridors, its form flickering like a dying candle. It does not attack unless provoked, but it will not let anyone pass without an offering.

sb_spends.name: Draining Touch
sb_spends.effect: A PC is touched by cold dread; they mark 1 Fatigue.

sb_spends.name: Terrifying Visage
sb_spends.effect: The Duskwight reveals its true form; a PC must test Spirit+Resolve (DV 3) or be Frightened (-1 die to all actions for one exchange).

sb_spends.name: Fade to Mist
sb_spends.effect: The Duskwight becomes incorporeal for one exchange, avoiding all physical attacks.

bestiary.lore: They were once guardians of the lantern, sworn to protect it from those who would misuse its power. They do not remember their names, only their duty.

bestiary.name: Quick Lena
bestiary.description: A brash young treasure hunter with quick fingers and a quicker temper. She's here for the lantern, and she doesn't intend to share.

sb_spends.name: Dirty Trick
sb_spends.effect: Lena throws dust in a PC's eyes; they act at Desperate for one exchange.

sb_spends.name: Slippery Escape
sb_spends.effect: Lena disengages from melee and moves to Near range without provoking opportunity.

sb_spends.name: Taunt
sb_spends.effect: Lena insults a PC, goading them into a reckless action; their next attack is at -1 die.

bestiary.lore: She's been chasing legends since she was a child. She doesn't know what the lantern does—she just knows it's worth something to someone.

bestiary.name: Barrow Guardian
bestiary.description: A crude statue of a warrior, animated by ancient magic. It stands motionless until the lantern is disturbed, then it lurches into action, its stone limbs grinding.

sb_spends.name: Stone Fist
sb_spends.effect: A PC is knocked Prone; they must spend an action to stand.

sb_spends.name: Shatter the Ground
sb_spends.effect: The Guardian slams the floor; all in Near must test Body+Athletics (DV 3) or be Slowed for one exchange.

sb_spends.name: Rumbling Charge
sb_spends.effect: The Guardian charges in a straight line; any PC in its path must test Body+Athletics (DV 4) or take Harm 2.

bestiary.lore: It was built to protect the lantern, but it has stood so long that it has forgotten its purpose. It attacks anything that moves, hoping to remember why it exists.

acts.title: The Lantern at Dusk
acts.description: Enter the barrow, face the Duskwights, confront Quick Lena, escape the collapse, and break the curse.

scenes.title: Scene 1 — The Entry
scenes.description: The barrow entrance is a narrow stone passage. A faint green glow pulses from deeper inside. A cave-in blocks the way.

timers.name: Barrow Collapse
timers.description: Ticks on failure inside. At 6, the entrance seals.

outcomes.clean: You clear the rubble and enter.
outcomes.partial: You get through but disturb rubble — tick Barrow Collapse +1.
outcomes.miss: You are pinned by a rock — mark Harm 1 and tick Collapse +1.

scenes.title: Scene 2 — The Spirit Corridor
scenes.description: The passage widens into a hall where three Duskwights drift. They do not attack unless provoked, but they will not let anyone pass without an offering.

encounters.name: Offer a Memory or a Secret

outcomes.clean: They bow and let you pass.
outcomes.partial: They take your offering but also steal a random piece of equipment.
outcomes.miss: They attack as a single mob (Cap 2, Harm 1 each, 2 Fatigue each on hit).

outcomes.clean: You defeat the Duskwights and pass through.
outcomes.partial: You drive them back, but they remain in the shadows — they will return later.
outcomes.miss: They overwhelm you; each PC takes Harm 2 and the Barrow Collapse timer advances by 2.

scenes.title: Scene 3 — The Lantern Chamber
scenes.description: The lantern sits on a stone altar. Quick Lena is there, trying to pry it loose.

timers.name: Lena's Agenda
timers.description: Ticks each scene inside. At 4, Lena takes the lantern first.

outcomes.clean: She leaves peacefully, but warns that 'others will come for it.'
outcomes.partial: She agrees to split any reward but demands a favor later (start a Debt Timer [4]).
outcomes.miss: She triggers a trap — a stone door starts closing (tick Collapse +2).

scenes.title: Scene 4 — Escape
scenes.description: After you take the lantern, the barrow begins to collapse in earnest. The party needs 3 successes before 2 failures to escape.

timers.name: Barrow Collapse
timers.description: Ticks on failure. At 6, entrance seals.

outcomes.clean: Each success counts toward the 3 needed; no extra tick.
outcomes.miss: Tick Collapse +1. If Collapse reaches 6, entrance seals — find another way.

scenes.title: Resolution — Breaking the Curse
scenes.description: Return the lantern to the stone circle. Breaking the curse requires a simple ritual.

outcomes.clean: The blight lifts. Elder Sarai rewards each PC with a String — 'The village owes you.'
outcomes.partial: The curse lifts, but the lantern cannot be destroyed — it will attract another danger soon.
outcomes.miss: The curse is only pushed back one year. A dark spirit escapes and will become a recurring enemy.

npcs.name: Elder Sarai
npcs.motivation: Save her village from the blight.

locations.name: The Old Barrow
locations.description: A moss-covered stone mound on a hill overlooking Duskwood.

locations.name: The Stone Circle
locations.description: A ring of standing stones in the valley below the barrow.

campaignTimers.name: Barrow Collapse
campaignTimers.description: Ticks when the party fails a roll inside. At 6, the entrance seals.

triggers.message: The entrance seals! Escape becomes a Desperate group action.

campaignTimers.name: Lena's Agenda
campaignTimers.description: Ticks at the end of each scene inside the barrow. When it fills, Lena has already taken the lantern.
